subject: How to "load" a data frame into Plot Builder (from Rattle)?

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: How to "load" a data frame into Plot Builder (from Rattle)?
parts:
Rattle (http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rattle/index.html) has an option to call Plot Builder under its Explore/Interactive tab. This is quite a popular option within Rattle.

Internally Rattle keeps its dataset (a data.frame) within an environment (accessible in R as crs$dataset) so as not to write in the user's workspace (as required by CRAN policy).

To have the Rattle dataset available to Plot Builder, Rattle copies the dataset into the user's workspace (contravening CRAN policy) by assigning crs$dataset into a variable, "ds", in .GlobalEnv. 

CRAN have asked that Rattle conform to the CRAN policy.

Checking the Deducer source code I see that get.objects() is used to identify the data.frames currently available in the user's workspace (i.e., .GlobalEnv) and to then make them available to Plot Builder.

Is there any other way of making data.frames (e.g. defined in other environments like Rattle's "crs") available to Plot Builder?
 
Thanks,
Graham
